backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor defining all backend logic including comment lists, global comment pool, user profiles, app events, chat messages, images, settings, earnings, and withdrawal management, with blob storage and authorization mixins included.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that converts the old actor's flat `globalComments` list into a new `Map<Nat, Comment>` structure with status tracking, used during canister upgrade.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking two UI features (error modal for single and bulk comment generation with pool stats refetch) to their relevant files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key changes, serving as a reference for build planning and code navigation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, border, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, mounting the app at `#root` and loading the TypeScript entry point via a module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component providing tabbed navigation across Comment, Single Gen, Bulk Gen, Live, Upload, and Admin views, with a countdown banner, theme toggle, and background music toggle.
frontend/src/components/AdminUnlock.tsx: Admin unlock screen component that validates an admin code via `useAdminAuth`, auto-skips if already authenticated via localStorage, and calls `onUnlocked` on success.
frontend/src/components/BulkCommentGener: A React component that lets users select a comment list, enter an access key, and generate multiple comments in bulk, with inventory tracking and clipboard copy support.
frontend/src/components/MetricsDonutChar: An SVG donut chart component that visualizes the percentage of used vs. total templates with a gradient arc and centered percentage label.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.t: A canvas-based top-down shooter mini-game where the player moves with keyboard input and shoots at enemies by clicking, tracking score and time.
frontend/src/components/UploadComment.ts: A form component that allows users to type and submit a comment via the addChatMessage mutation, showing loading, success, and error states.
A modal dialog that displays a user's earnings and collects a 10-digit wallet number to submit a withdrawal request via mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing admin access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: A hook that manages admin authentication state using a hardcoded code, persisting unlock status in localStorage and exposing unlock/lock methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: A hook that manages an HTML Audio element for background music playback, supporting enable/disable toggling and exposing play/pause controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useClaimedComments.ts: A hook that stores and retrieves per-device, per-list claimed comment records in localStorage, keyed by device ID and list ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Provides a hook with `generate` and `generateBulk` functions that randomly pick templates from a `CommentList`, optionally appending a suffix or symbol.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: React hook that returns a live countdown (hours, minutes, seconds) to midnight, updating every second via `setInterval`.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: React hook that retrieves or generates a persistent UUID device ID stored in `localStorage`.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for interacting with the backend actor, covering comment lists, events, settings, earnings, withdrawals, and more.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind, and defines CSS custom properties for dark and light themes including color tokens for gold, teal, backgrounds, and countdown banner styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/utils/liveListParser.ts: Parses a structured text report into an array of `ParsedAppEntry` objects by detecting date lines, app name blocks (wrapped in asterisks), and numbered username lines.
frontend/src/utils/templateGenerator.ts: Generates randomized app review comment templates by combining tone-specific adjectives and phrase banks across categories (performance, UI, features, support) with configurable length suffixes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those parameters via sessionStorage and history.replaceState.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminAITemplate: Admin view for generating templated comments by topic and tone using a local template engine, with options to select generated templates and add them to a comment list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminChat.tsx: Admin chat panel that displays and sends chat messages stored on the backend, with auto-scroll to the latest message.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.t: Admin view for managing comment lists, supporting create, rename, delete, lock/unlock, bulk template addition, and per-list inventory count management with metrics visualization.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminEarnings.t: Admin earnings dashboard that displays summary stats and a per-app earnings breakdown fetched from the backend, with a manual refresh button.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminImages.tsx: Admin UI for uploading images with a name, tags, and file preview, displaying all existing images fetched via a query hook.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLiveList.t: Admin UI for managing app events and their associated username lists, supporting create/delete events, bulk username upload, and auto-import via a parsed live list report.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminPoolManage: Admin UI for viewing global comment pool stats (available, claimed, total) and adding new comment templates to the pool in bulk.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminPricing.ts: Admin UI for managing per-app price entries with support for adding, editing, deleting, and bulk uploading pricing data via CSV-style text input.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin UI for managing the application access key (view, set, or regenerate) and toggling background music via settings query hooks.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminView.tsx: Top-level admin panel component that renders a tab-based navigation across all admin sub-views (comments, live list, pricing, earnings, withdrawals, AI templates, images, chat, pool, settings) with an auth gate.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminWithdrawal: React admin view that displays all withdrawal requests fetched via a custom hook, showing pending/approved/rejected stats and a scrollable table of individual requests with status badges and formatted timestamps.
frontend/src/views/BulkGeneratorView.tsx: React view that lets users generate a batch of comments (up to 1000) from the global pool, displaying pool stats and allowing individual or bulk clipboard copying of results.
frontend/src/views/LiveChecker.tsx: React view for checking whether one or more usernames appear in app event lists, supporting single and bulk modes, app filtering, earnings calculation, and a withdrawal modal.
frontend/src/views/SingleGeneratorView.t: React view that generates a single comment from the global pool, shows pool stats, and provides a copy-to-clipboard button with error modal feedback.
frontend/src/views/UploadView.tsx: React view providing three upload workflows: adding comment templates from a text file to a selected list, generating bulk comments via a component, and uploading named rating images with preview.
frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx: Main user-facing view that lets users select a comment list, claim/generate a unique comment, and copy it to clipboard, with localStorage persistence to prevent duplicate claims.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Orbitron, Rajdhani), OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations; includes tailwindcss-animate, typography, and container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 9) describing the Review Empire ICP app architecture, existing features (single/bulk comment generators, admin pool management), known backend issues, and a note that only backend fixes should be applied.
